title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E11 — Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began for Martha in the 1970s; then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour - a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E12 — Color For All Seasons
One of the joys of gardening is planning for beautiful color all through the year; bulbs and tubers are at the center of this show because of their beautiful blooms from spring to winter.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E1 — Martha's Easy Foundation Landscaping Project
Martha redesigns the foundation landscaping around one of the homes on her Bedford Farm, providing step-by-step instructions on how to complete a successful landscaping project with ease and intent.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E9 — Martha and the Chocolate Factory
Martha visits Mast Market in Mt. Kisco, N.Y., and learns the art behind making their renowned chocolate; from roasting cacao, to stone grinding, to forming delicious bars and chips.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E2 — India: A Tour of Food
Martha's friend and restaurateur, Shiva Natarajan, shares the key to making any Indian dish - spices; back in Martha's kitchen, they make butter chicken, lemon rice, and a tangy yogurt sauce.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E3 — Magic Mushrooms
Martha learns about the magic of mushrooms; mushroom expert Andrew Carter explains each mushroom variety; Martha and mushroom cookbook author Andrea Gentl make delicious mushroom recipes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E4 — Picture Perfect Rolled Lasagna
Restaurant owners Angie Rito and Scott Tacinelli join Martha in making their rolled lasagna with San Marzano tomato sauce, Italian bolognese, and chrysanthemum Caesar salad.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E5 — Easy Homemade Dumplings
Martha, Monica Tran Carden, and Andrew Yu make homemade dumplings; Martha and Monica hand-make wontons and pork dumplings; Andrew and Martha prepare jade dumplings and pork and shrimp dumplings.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E6 — The Bagel Show
Martha samples bagel toppings and is joined by Gary Greengrass, owner of Barney Greengrass, an NYC staple; at PopUp Bagels, Martha makes bagels and constructs breakfast sandwiches with Adam Goldberg.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E7 — Martha's Favorite Cakes
Martha makes the classic meringue cake from Casa Cipriani with pastry chef Alessia Tomassetti; Martha and bakery owner Lucie Franc De Ferriere bake a pear raspberry cake with jam and maple buttercream.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E1 — Martha Hosts a Derby Party
Kevin Sharkey makes mint juleps and deviled eggs; a Churchill Downs Racetrack centerpiece; chef Pierre Schaedelin walks Martha through food preparation for the party; Martha gets fitted by hat milliner Jackie Ciconga for the perfect Derby ensemble.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E1 — Strawberry Pots; Shower Curtain; Succulents; Sugared Flowers
Planting strawberries; custom shower curtain; succulents in stone wall; cake decoration.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E2 — Brick Edging; Shortcake; Ribbon Bulletin Board
Brick border; strawberry shortcake; building a trellis; wood stains.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E3 — Baked Apples; Mesh for Glass; Freezing Berries
Window boxes; baked apples, replacing glass with mesh; raspberry trellis; freezing berries.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E4 — French Toast; Rose Cutting; Sharpening Tools; Artichokes
French toast; roses; sharpening tools; cooking artichokes.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E5 — Belgian Fence Espalier; Boning Chicken; Chicken Stock
Pruning fruit trees; cutting up a chicken; soup stock; consignment shops.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E7 — Ribbon Lampshade; Rolled Linen; Photo Album; Video Boxes
Ribbon lampshade; freshly ironed tablecloth; customized photo albums.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E10 — Pork
Porchetta, a highly seasoned roasted pork; glazed ham; pork and plums.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E3 — Steakhouse
Baked stuffed clams; searing a porterhouse steak; creamed spinach; baked potatoes with various garnishes.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E5 — Sandwiches
Five classic sandwiches -- roasted chicken club, New Orleans po'boy with oysters, muffuletta, applewood-smoked bacon and fried egg sandwich, and a Reuben.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E7 — French Bistro Classics
Lamb navarin; Niçoise salad; a melted ham and cheese croque monsieur topped with a béchamel sauce; celery root rémoulade.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E8 — The Grind
Glazed meatloaf; hot Italian-style pork sausage; making burgers using a custom blend of meats; meatballs with ricotta.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E9 — Cooking With Wine
Beef bourguignon; cioppino, a tomato and wine-based fish stew; chicken Marsala; poached pears in red or white wine.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E2 — Growing Citrus
Martha explores the incredible world of citrus from yuzus and kumquats to citrons and mandarins; Martha visits Flavors by Bhumi in her home state of New Jersey to learn all about growing citrus.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E3 — Getting the Garden Going
Martha prepares her garden for the season's splendor - from planting hellebores to propagating trees to proper lawn care; plus, succulent pots for early color.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E4 — Tropical Plants That Can Grow Anywhere
Martha travels to Florida for all things tropical plants; Martha explores inspiring gardens and landscapes in Palm Beach, highlighting diverse varieties of tropical plants that can be grown anywhere.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E5 — Container Gardening Made Easy
Martha shares the dos and don'ts of container gardening from choosing what to plant and the right container to sharing her key tips for nutrient-rich soil; a glossary of underplantings to give potted plants a finished look.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E6 — Growing Fruit and Berries
Martha shares tips on the many different varieties of fruits and berries she cultivates on her farm; a lesson on growing raspberries, currants, and blueberries; Matt Kaminsky teaches Martha how to prune and care for her hundred-year-old apple trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E1 — Martha's Amazing Maze and How to Grow Trees From Seedlings
Martha's new passion project is the maze she's building on her Bedford farm; she shares her plans and inspiration for the project and teaches the proper measuring, staking and fertilizing techniques to properly plant successful trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E2 — Everything You Need To Know About Conifers
Martha shows how to properly move an established tree on her very own Christmas tree farm; she gives a tour of her pinetum where she teaches about new and unusual conifer trees.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S11 E12 — Pantry Milks
Dairy trade secrets; using pantry milk in passion fruit meringue pie and cuatro leches cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E2 — Pate Brisee
Flaky pâte brisée crust; mile-high apple pie; tomato tart.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E11 — Yeast Dough
Yeast dough treats include pecan sticky buns and pull-apart monkey bread.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E12 — Biscuits and Scones
Buttermilk biscuits; angel biscuits; cream scones.
